result.summary: Found 1 issue: a loading spinner remains overlaid on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image even though the photo is fully rendered.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner is centered over the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card image, even though the ramen photo behind it is fully rendered and sharp. The indicator appears stuck and obscures the food image.
issues.suggestion: Dismiss the loading indicator as soon as the image finishes loading, and only show it while the image is actually loading so it does not cover loaded content.
